analysis.title: ADT Inc. (ADT): To be acquired by Thrive Holdings for $10/shr
key_insights: ADT agreed on 10/29/2026 to be acquired by Thrive Holdings in an all-cash deal at $10.00/shr, implying equity value of ~$7.6bn and enterprise value of ~$15.3bn.
The $10.00 price is a 45.6% premium to the unaffected close of $6.87 on 10/27/2026 and 52.1% above the 30-day VWAP ending 10/27/2026.
ADT's Board unanimously approved the deal. Close is expected in 1Q27, subject to ADT stockholder approval, US antitrust approval and customary conditions. There is no financing condition.
The merger agreement lets ADT solicit alternative proposals through 11/28/2026 (go-shop), with a possible 10-day extension for certain parties that submit proposals in the initial period.
ADT will report 3Q26 results on 11/3/2026 with a 10am ET call and will not take questions because of the pending transaction.

Goldman Sachs is Not Rated on ADT because it is acting as financial advisor on the announced transaction. Price target and estimates are removed under GS policy, though the cover table still shows GS forecasts for revenue, EBITDA and EPS.
ADT closed at $7.41 on 10/28/2026, below the $10.00 offer price.

market_movers.rationale: Acquisition by Thrive Holdings at $10.00 cash per share. GS is Not Rated and advising on the deal, so there is no GS view on the stock.

earnings_insights: ADT plans to report 3Q 2026 results on 11/3/2026, with a call at 10am ET and no questions taken.
GS forecast EPS (cover table): $0.89 for 12/25 (actual), $0.92 for 12/26E, $1.02 for 12/27E, $1.17 for 12/28E. Quarterly GS EPS: $0.24 for 6/26, $0.23 for 9/26E, $0.22 for 12/26E, $0.26 for 3/27E.

GS forecast revenue (cover table) is $5,128.5mn for 12/25, $5,232.2mn for 12/26E, $5,422.7mn for 12/27E and $5,625.9mn for 12/28E. EBITDA is $2,680.1mn for 12/25, $2,645.8mn for 12/26E, $2,679.7mn for 12/27E and $2,727.1mn for 12/28E.
risk_factors: Deal requires ADT stockholder approval and US antitrust approval, and could fail to close in 1Q27.
The go-shop period through 11/28/2026 allows alternative proposals, which could change the deal terms or counterparty.
Goldman Sachs has a conflict of interest: it is advising on the transaction and has investment banking relationships with ADT.
